# kcore_ssh_keys (Data Source)

List SSH public keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kcore_ssh_keys" "all" {}

output "ssh_key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.kcore_ssh_keys.all.keys : k.name]
}
```
